method_notes: Sources actually read: Clash Royale Fandom Glossary + Deck: namespace (via MediaWiki API; HTML was 403), deckmelon.com per-card 'best-decks/with/<card>' pages (333 deck cards parsed with names, 8 cards, win rate, battle counts), royaletracker.gg/best-decks/archetypes, RoyaleAPI deck-stats page titles from search results ('Log Bait', 'X-Bow Hog'), gamerant archetype guide.
Deck Shop (deckshop.pro) and RoyaleAPI HTML were Cloudflare-blocked (403) for both WebFetch and curl; only their page titles from search results were usable.
deckmelon deck names are site-assigned; many named decks show 0 recorded battles (recently added). Battle counts are quoted where they matter.

Fandom Deck: namespace is user-submitted (500+ pages, e.g. '1.6 Hog Rider', 'Cock and Ball with Pubes Hyperbait'); used only for '2.6 Hog', 'LavaLoon', 'P.E.K.K.A. Bridge Spam', 'Bridge Spam' which are curated guide pages.

Family is the single best fit from the closed set; several cards straddle (Balloon: beatdown vs cycle; Royal Hogs: control vs bridge_spam; Mega Knight: bridge_spam vs control; Mortar Bait: siege with bait cards).
